# downsocial YouTube Video Downloader
> Free online tool to download YouTube Videos, Shorts, and 320kbps MP3 audio in up to 4K UHD resolution without watermarks, ads, or logins.

## Canonical URL
- https://downsocial.net/youtube-downloader/

## Documentation & Full Information

## Key Capabilities
- YouTube Video Downloader in 720p, 1080p Full HD, 2K, and 4K UHD
- YouTube Shorts 1-Click Fast Downloader with original audio sync
- High-fidelity YouTube to MP3 audio converter (192kbps - 320kbps)
- Zero added watermarks, zero pop-up ads, zero subscription fees
- No Google account login or software installation required
- Ultra-fast cloud streaming proxy across iPhone, Android, and PC
